customManagers.description: Update PYTHON_VERSION and ALPINE_VERSION in the Containerfile together as one python:<version>-alpine<version> tag. The tags are looked up on Docker Hub because the registry.osism.tech proxy cache does not list them.
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
ARG PYTHON_VERSION={{{replace '-alpine.*$' '' newValue}}}
ARG ALPINE_VERSION={{{replace '^.*-alpine' '' newValue}}}

packageRules.description: The dockerfile manager detects the same base image, but it cannot list tags through the proxy cache; the custom manager above handles it
Keep Python patch and Alpine updates separate from Python minor updates so they are not held back by an unmerged minor bump
